scope.goal: Classify Next.js app router compatibility before product support is claimed.

capabilities.reason: Requires actual Next CLI/module execution, file watching, route worker lifecycle, and SWC transform path inside the product runtime.
Requires SWC transform path, filesystem metadata compatibility, worker lifecycle, and native optional dependency diagnostics.
May become supportable after WASM SWC and build-time filesystem contracts are verified; runtime server features remain out of scope.
Native platform packages and native .node addons are outside the browser runtime support scope.
A version-matched WASM package exists, but it still needs integration with the runtime WASM adapter policy and Next's loader path.

gate.supportDecision: Do not claim Next.js product support yet. Track static export and WASM SWC as candidates; keep full app router dev/build on hold until runtime module execution, worker, watcher, and SWC paths are verified.
